title: qa mutant registry (qa/mutants.json) and verifier proposals (<verification>/mutants.json)
description: Breakage checks: each mutant is an edit (find, exactly once in file, replaced by replace) and the test that must turn red when it is made. `qa run` runs only the proposals that name their killing test (kill), and runs only that test, unmutated and then mutated; the registry's mutants run only on an explicit --mutants all (or affected). The suites live in qa/suites.* (schema/suites.schema.json); a registry's own `suites` is the old place, read only while the project has no suites file. The engine adds origin ('registry' or 'verify') itself; it is not written here.

suites.description: The old place of the suites (now qa/suites.*): read only while the project has no suites file. Leave it out of a new registry

breaks.description: What breaks, as a person or the data would suffer it

file.description: Path relative to the repo root, '/'-separated

find.description: Must occur exactly once in file, or the mutant is stale

suite.description: A key of the suites: the suite run whole for this mutant under --mutants all|affected. Leave it out when kill names the suite

kill.description: The one test that must fail when the edit is made: green unmutated, red mutated is killed; still green is SURVIVED (a guard no test holds). The same shape as a test expectation's `test`

suite.description: A key of the suites, or 'test:<level>'

grep.description: The test's own title (a part unique to it), or '/re/flags'

file.description: The test file it is in, relative to the repo root: only that file runs
